title: Lokayukta police trap GST official with Rs 8 lakh bribe
content: A Central GST official was apprehended by Lokayukta police for accepting a bribe.  The superintendent demanded twenty lakh rupees from a businessman to close a tax evasion case.  He agreed to accept eight lakh rupees and used an agent for the transaction.  The businessman reported the demand, leading to the trap and arrests of both men.  Both the official and his agent were sent to judicial custody following the operation.

title: iPhone buying guide: iPhone 18 Pro vs iPhone Duo vs iPhone 17, which one to buy
content: Apple's iPhone lineup in India now runs from Rs 79,900 to Rs 2,99,900, and the newest model is no longer the obvious buy. The 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max arrive with variable aperture and the A20 Pro, the foldable iPhone Duo lands in October, and there is no new standard model this year. Here is what each iPhone gives you, who it suits, and which ones to walk past.

title: India’s Chef de Mission admits accommodation crisis, reveals additional rooms booked
content: India's Chef de Mission acknowledged the struggle with accommodation shortages at the Asian Games. Following a reduction in their allocated rooms, the Indian contingent successfully secured more hotel spaces. Additionally, challenges arose from transport and accreditation logistics, which compounded the difficulties. An unexpected delay also affected the flag-hoisting ceremony, but India's focus continues to be on ensuring the comfort and performance of its athletes throughout the Games.

title: 12-year-old repaired 114 stuffed animals for children who lost homes in fires
content: In a heartwarming initiative, a young girl from North Carolina took it upon herself to collect discarded stuffed animals from local thrift shops. After cleaning and lovingly restoring 114 toys, she donated them to children affected by home loss due to a fire. This project not only offered solace to struggling children but also emphasized the importance of recycling and giving toys a new lease on life.

title: iPhone 18, 18 Pro Max sale starts: Where to buy, Rs 7,000 flat cashback & more
content: The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max have officially hit the shelves in India, available at both authorized retailers and online. Shoppers can take advantage of exciting launch offers like bank cashbacks and no-cost EMI options. Additionally, the improved trade-in program offers hefty discounts on older devices. Buyers will also enjoy complimentary subscriptions to Apple's most popular digital services.

title: Detectorists found 2,584 silver pennies; hoard later valued at £4.3 million
content: Recently, a noteworthy trove of Norman-era silver coins was obtained for the nation, worth £4.3 million, establishing it as the most significant treasure discovery in British history. This cache highlights the political turmoil that ensued post-Norman Conquest of England. Thanks to funding from the National Lottery Heritage Fund, this historic treasure will be displayed nationwide and will eventually find its way back to Somerset.

title: Sebi warned on digital gold in 2025; now physical backing and oversight in works
content: The finance ministry has sought feedback from regulators, banks and other stakeholders. A broad consensus has emerged that digital gold should be classified as a security under the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956.

title: 'Nothing against sportsman spirit': Pakistan explain decision to boycott Israel
content: Pakistan refused to play Israel in the opening round of the 2026 Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, handing Israel a 4-0 walkover. Pakistan’s chess federation said the decision followed the government’s policy of not recognising Israel and was also meant to show solidarity with Palestinians. Officials stressed the boycott was about state policy, not the players or sporting spirit.

title: Air India Express ordered to pay Rs 27K after bicycle put on baggage belt
content: A consumer commission ordered Air India Express to refund a fee.  The airline mishandled a passenger's bicycle despite special handling payment.  The commission found deficiency in service after the bicycle appeared on the regular belt.  Air India Express must now pay compensation and litigation costs to the passenger.  The total amount ordered to be paid is Rs 27,000.

title: Sikh truck driver stabbed 17 times in Wyoming days after DHS's ‘Mr Singh’ post
content: A Sikh truck driver was brutally stabbed seventeen times in Wyoming.  This attack occurred just four days after a controversial US government post.  Sikh Americans are demanding a full investigation into the assault.  They want authorities to determine if hate played a role in the incident.  The community fears this incident reflects a concerning climate for them.

title: ‘Clear message’ for Hardik: Gambhir reveals what he must do to return to Team India
content: India's coach Gautam Gambhir emphasised that Hardik Pandya needs to improve his match fitness before rejoining the national squad. Playing in upcoming games, including potential matches for India A, will be crucial for Pandya to restore his form. Additionally, the team is focusing on Nitish Kumar Reddy's growth as a seam-bowling all-rounder, aiming for a roster that offers versatility for future competitions.

title: Watch: Songs, car rally as men back accused in Gurgaon woman biker hit-and-run case
content: Men rallied in cars supporting Kalyan Singh Bainsla, accused in a Gurgaon hit-and-run incident.  Bainsla allegedly chased and rammed a biker, Shivani Chauhan, on Golf Course Road.  Investigators are reconstructing the events and questioning associates present during the incident.  The accused were taken to the spot for a sequence of events reconstruction.  A local court had sent Bainsla and an associate to police custody.

title: One win from history: India’s Quimcy Dsouza storms into Teqball semis at Asian Games
content: Quimcy Joaquim Dsouza has advanced to the semifinals of Teqball after a gripping comeback victory over Japan's top seed Yuina Sakamoto. Following this, she showcased her skills by securing a decisive win against Cambodia's Koemyean DY. This outstanding performance not only cements her place in the semifinals but also positions her for a potential historic medal for India, where she will challenge Indonesia's Ima Sumaya next.

title: Raped, stabbed, body dumped: Delhi teen goes to meet friend, he calls 3 others
content: A 16-year-old girl was raped and murdered in Swaroop Nagar, Delhi. Four youths, including three minors, were apprehended by police in connection. Investigators are verifying the suspects' claims about their involvement in the crime. Forensic evidence and recovered weapons are being examined by the dedicated team. The tempo used in the incident has also been seized by authorities.

title: ‘Body kept in car for 7 hours’: How a Gurgaon meeting ended in HR professional’s murder
content: A 31-year-old HR professional was allegedly murdered after meeting a former colleague. Police arrested the former colleague, Anya Vats, and her partner, Sanyam Sachdeva. Investigators suspect a financial dispute led to the alleged killing of Yuvraj Singh Manchanda. The couple reportedly confessed to dumping the body in a sewer near their home. They were apprehended in Uttarakhand after fleeing the scene.

title: Punjab: ASI shot dead, 2nd attack on a cop within a week

The Chief Minister announced an ex-gratia payment of one crore rupees for the family. This killing follows recent attacks on police personnel in Punjab. Investigations are underway to identify those responsible for the shooting.

title: MP shocker: Man attacks wife at hospital for ‘birthing daughter’

This violent act occurred after the woman welcomed twins, including a baby girl. The victim's family argues that the assault highlights underlying gender bias. Reports from the hospital revealed a fierce argument before the physical confrontation. Police are now probing the circumstances and the injuries involved.

title: Rajkot man kills 5-year-old daughter, stores body in fridge; ends life
content: A father allegedly murdered his five-year-old daughter in Rajkot due to financial difficulties. He then placed her decorated body inside the refrigerator before taking his own life. Preliminary investigations and suicide notes pointed towards severe financial distress from a construction project. The man had also invested personal loan money into the ill-fated construction site. Police are examining the circumstances surrounding the tragic events in the village.

title: A month before Gurgaon hit-and-run case, men chased, harassed Bhopal biker

Abhishek finished the three-match series with 229 runs, including two centuries, responding strongly after facing pressure following a difficult Zimbabwe series.

content: the poll panel told the apex court that tribunals appointed by the court have disposed of only about 1.02 lakh of the 38.20 lakh appeals filed so far . this comes after a bench of chief justice Surya Kant and justices Joymala Bagchi and V Mohana sought the panel's response to a plea seeking disclosure of assembly constituency-wise data on claims and objections .

title: FSSAI flags Nestle infant products over false promotional claims, biotin levels
content: the food safety and standards authority of India (FSSAI) initiated legal action against Nestle India over alleged non-compliance involving its infant nutrition products . the regulator flagged claims relating to “5 HMOs” and “Whey Protein” for Lactogen Pro 1 .

content: a group of men were seen rallying in cars in support of the accused . a video showed several cars driving together on a flyover in Haryana . police said he was returning from a club with his friends when the incident took place .

title: ‘Are you people students?’ Delhi HC flays ABVP, NSUI over DUSU poll violations
content: the court was hearing a plea alleging violence and other violations during the DUSU election campaign . the bench also questioned the Delhi Police over alleged cavalcades of vehicles, some without number plates, in North Campus .

title: 'Football player' vs 'envelope': EC allots new names and symbols to TMC factions
content: a rival group is allotted the name "Democratic Trinamool Congress" and the symbol of "envelope" this comes a day after the poll panel ruled that neither faction of TMC can use its name or "flowers and grass" symbol .

title: Surinder Koli, acquitted in 2006 Nithari serial killings case, dies by suicide
content: surinder Koli was acquitted in the last remaining case linked to the 2006 killings . his body was found at a tea stall in the Bhupatwala area, near the Lal Mata temple . no suicide note had been found and an investigation is under way .

title: Explosive-laden truck rams into mosque in Pakistan's Kohat; 16 dead
content: blast occurred during prayers, collapsing part of the mosque and triggering rescue operation . emergency teams rushed to the site after receiving information about the explosion . the injured were taken to nearby hospitals for treatment . roads leading to the blast site were closed .
